edges.reason: msg.sender is used in mint as the minter address and gift address source.
block.timestamp is used as a randomness seed in randomNum, making the result miner-influenceable.
headStart is derived from block.timestamp and gates withdraw.
randomNum output determines giftAddress inside mint.
mint performs an external low-level value call to giftAddress after state updates via _safeMint.
mint invokes _safeMint which calls onERC721Received on the receiving contract.
mint reads maxSupply to enforce the supply cap.
mint reads paused to block minting when paused.
mint reads cost to validate msg.value.
withdraw performs external low-level value calls that transfer the whole balance.
withdraw compares block.timestamp against headStart to allow withdrawal.
withdraw is protected by onlyOwner which reads the _owner state variable.
reveal is onlyOwner and writes the revealed state variable.
setCost is onlyOwner and writes the cost state variable.
setNotRevealedURI is onlyOwner and writes notRevealedUri.
setBaseURI is onlyOwner and writes baseURI.
setBaseExtension is onlyOwner and writes baseExtension.
pause is onlyOwner and writes the paused flag.
_baseURI returns the stored baseURI.
tokenURI branches on the revealed flag.
tokenURI reads baseURI via _baseURI.
tokenURI appends baseExtension to the metadata URI.
withdraw resolves onlyOwner through _msgSender(), i.e. msg.sender.
constructor delegates to setBaseURI to initialize baseURI.
constructor delegates to setNotRevealedURI to initialize notRevealedUri.
onERC721Received callback is invoked with msg.sender as the operator, allowing external reentry before mint completes.

normalization_plan.reason: Local supply only exists to bound and index the mint operation.
Local giftAddress is only used as the target of the mint gift call.
Local giftValue is only used as the amount of the mint gift call.
Local success flag only checks the outcome of the mint gift call.
Local num is the sole return value of randomNum.
Local count only supports the walletOfOwner enumeration loop.
Local array is the return value built by walletOfOwner.
Local d only checks the 10 percent transfer inside withdraw.
Local s only checks the remaining balance transfer inside withdraw.
Local cache is only used to build the tokenURI result.
